entries.name: Example Brief Bot
entries.summary: EXAMPLE only. Shows the catalog shape for a weekly research brief that never sends mail.
entries.job: Produce a weekly research brief from sources the owner names. Never send, never create events, never enable routines until asked.
entries.what_it_does: Reads named sources, drafts a short brief, waits for approval.
entries.first_safe_task: Summarize this conversation in three bullets. Do not send mail or create events.
entries.approval_boundary: Never send, pay, delete, or file anything without an explicit yes in chat.
